table_description: Dimension table containing 100 million customer records. Each row is one unique customer with personal details, preferences, and birth information. This is the central customer dimension — join to STORE_SALES, CATALOG_SALES, or WEB_SALES via their respective customer SK foreign keys.
use_cases: Customer acquisition cohort analysis (first sale date)
data_quality_notes: C_PREFERRED_CUST_FLAG is 'Y' or 'N' — not a boolean. Always use = 'Y' to filter preferred customers.
C_BIRTH_YEAR, C_BIRTH_MONTH, C_BIRTH_DAY store date parts separately — reconstruct as DATE using TRY_TO_DATE(C_BIRTH_YEAR||'-'||C_BIRTH_MONTH||'-'||C_BIRTH_DAY) for age calculations.
C_CURRENT_ADDR_SK is the current address — join to CUSTOMER_ADDRESS for the latest address.
C_CURRENT_CDEMO_SK links to CUSTOMER_DEMOGRAPHICS for current demographic profile.
C_FIRST_SALES_DATE_SK is when the customer made their first purchase ever.
C_EMAIL_ADDRESS may be NULL for older customer records.
C_LOGIN can be NULL for customers who have not registered an online account.

table_columns.name: C_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Used as FK in all sales fact tables.

table_columns.name: C_CUSTOMER_ID
table_columns.description: Business key (natural key) for the customer. Unique alphanumeric ID.

table_columns.name: C_CURRENT_CDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: FK to CUSTOMER_DEMOGRAPHICS. Current demographic profile.

table_columns.name: C_CURRENT_HDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: FK to HOUSEHOLD_DEMOGRAPHICS. Current household profile.

table_columns.name: C_CURRENT_ADDR_SK
table_columns.description: FK to CUSTOMER_ADDRESS. Current address. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: C_FIRST_SHIPTO_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM. Date of first ship-to transaction.

table_columns.name: C_FIRST_SALES_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM. Date of first purchase ever. Use for cohort analysis.

table_columns.name: C_SALUTATION
table_columns.description: Title: Mr., Mrs., Ms., Dr., etc.

table_columns.name: C_PREFERRED_CUST_FLAG
table_columns.description: Preferred customer flag: 'Y' or 'N'. Not a boolean — use = 'Y'.

table_columns.name: C_BIRTH_DAY
table_columns.description: Day of birth (1-31). Combined with C_BIRTH_MONTH and C_BIRTH_YEAR for full birthdate.

table_columns.name: C_BIRTH_YEAR
table_columns.description: Year of birth (e.g. 1975). Use for age calculation.

table_columns.name: C_LOGIN
table_columns.description: Online login username. NULL if no online account.

table_columns.name: C_LAST_REVIEW_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM. Date of last account review.
